exposure: median respiratory rate (RR) in the previous 12 hours
outcome: early successful weaning from continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP)
cohort: The study included 145 preterm infants less than 32 0/7 weeks gestational age who were weaned off CPAP.
finding: Higher gestational age, absence of patent ductus arteriosus, and lower median respiratory rate in the 12 hours prior to CPAP cessation were predictive of early successful weaning in preterm infants.
